measures: Room booking in a Go service, with a requirement that lists features and no business rules: does the agent write a design document and leave the code alone? The rubric's invariants have to be inferred.
not_measured: The quality of the design, and whether the code was left alone: these checks only see that a design document exists and that the content of one set-up source file still exists somewhere in the world, so a rewritten file with a kept copy passes. eval/design-judge.py reads the saved run afterwards; it excludes a run that changed a set-up file or added a file outside docs/, and judges the document against eval/design-rubrics/, which this runner does not read.
prompt: docs/requirement.md 是这次要做的需求。先不要写代码，给出技术设计，写到 docs/design.md。
setup: Go 服务。现有分层：handler / service / dal。存储 MySQL，对外 HTTP，内部 RPC。
- 员工可以预约某个会议室的一个时间段。
- 预约提交后需要发起人在 10 分钟内确认，否则作废。
- 预约开始前 15 分钟给参会人发提醒。
- 管理员可以停用会议室。
- 办公区有 200 间会议室，上午 9 点到 10 点是预约高峰。
